name: Nuquí (Colombia)
description: Divided diagonally by a white wavy band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, green above and blue below.
history: Municipal flag of Nuquí, a municipality in the department of Chocó, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: wavy diagonal band along the division
